missing_evidence: Order-service server-side logs/traces showing the internal exception causing its 500
Order-service dependency metrics (inventory, payment, postgresql) to identify the failing call
candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders, which the gateway surfaces as 502 on POST /v1/checkout. Traces show order spans failing with '500 Internal Server Error' for http://order:8000/v1/orders, and gateway client logs record 500 from server_address=order, so the checkout 502s originate from order-service server errors.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause within order service (db, payment, inventory) is not yet established; only the 500 origin is bounded.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s are explained by order-service 500s: traces and gateway client logs both show POST /v1/orders returning 500, and topology confirms gateway->order. The specific internal fault in order service is not yet evidenced, so the candidate is bounded to the observed 500 origin.
